WITH CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest AS (
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ORDER BY PeriodStartDate DESC) AS RowNumber, * 
    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    )
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.CustomerAccountId)) FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
    LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
    WHERE A.AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND A.PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27' 
    AND B.ProductId NOT LIKE '09%'

WITH CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest AS (

    FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
    WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
    )
SELECT TOP 10 * FROM
    (SELECT A.CustomerAccountId, A.PeriodEndDate, A.AccumulatedCurrentBalance, B.ProductId FROM bnkm.CasaTdAggregateBalance A
        LEFT JOIN (SELECT * FROM CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_Latest WHERE RowNumber = 1) B ON B.CustomerAccountId = A.CustomerAccountId AND B.FinancialInstitutionId = A.FinancialInstitutionId
        WHERE A.AggregateBalanceType = 'Year-to-Date Average Daily Balance' AND A.PeriodEndDate = '2023-01-27' 
        AND B.ProductId NOT LIKE '09%') BNKM

    (SELECT AccountID, BusinessDateSK, AverageDailBalanceAmountYTDFull FROM dw.FactAverageDailyBalanceYTD 
    WHERE BusinessDateSK = 20230127) DW
ON BNKM.CustomerAccountId = DW.AccountID
    WHERE BNKM.CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL AND DW.AccountID IS NULL
